subject: Orchid Systems — Archer onboarding checklist and upload plan
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@orchidsystems.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai; jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@orchidsystems.com
Date: Tue, 23 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding — Archer account + evidence upload

Hi Laura / Jonas,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We are ready to get Orchid Systems set up in your Archer tenant so we can respond to the SIG/CAIQ and upload our SOC 2 artifacts. A couple of clarifying items before we start: 

- Do you prefer a direct API ingestion or will we upload artifacts through the UI (SFTP/one-time upload)?
- Which evidence fields are mandatory for a first pass SIG (we have prefilled the attached Orchid_Security_Template_SIG.xlsx)?
- We need a single point of contact who will have access to view uploaded docs and mark items as reviewed.

Proposed timeline: we can prepare the first evidence bundle by next Wednesday (2028-05-30) if we can confirm the preferred upload mechanism today.

I've attached the SIG template and our internal contact list. Alex (cc'd) will coordinate uploads and procurement will follow up on the contract addendum.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Head of Security Programs
Orchid Systems

Attachment: Orchid_Security_Template_SIG.xlsx (spreadsheet - manifest + answers)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@orchidsystems.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — Archer account + evidence upload

Hi Samira — great to meet you virtually. Thank you for the template. A couple of quick answers and next steps: 

- Preferred path: Archer UI upload for initial onboarding (faster to review). We recommend using the temporary presigned upload links we can generate for you if you don't want to create a dedicated SFTP account. After the first pass we can discuss API sync for continual evidence refresh.
- Mandatory fields for our first review: SIG answers, SOC 2 report (PDF), name and role of evidence custodian, and any key KMS/certification screenshots you have. We will redact any internal-only items on our side if needed.
- Point of contact: I'll be the primary reviewer for the Orchid profile; Karthik will own contract/procurement touchpoints and Jonas will coordinate evidence ingestion with our portal team.

Action items from Redwood:
1) We'll send a short onboarding guide and one-time presigned upload instructions (attached).
2) Create an Archer placeholder profile for Orchid with reviewer access for laura.bennett@redwood.ai and uploader access for samira.khan@orchidsystems.com.
3) Provide a list of non-negotiable artifacts for initial signoff (SOC 2, SIG spreadsheet, key management screenshots).

Target milestone: initial bundle uploaded by 2028-05-30; internal review completed by 2028-06-02. If that works on your side we'll proceed.

Attached: redwood-archer-onboard-guide.pdf

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

Thanks Samira — and thanks Laura for the plan. Quick commercial note: per our pre-discussion the onboarding work is included in our standard onboarding for enterprise customers, but our legal team is awaiting the minimal addendum from procurement (cc'd) that references evidence retention and liability language. Our deal id is RDW-2028-4382 and I'm happy to loop legal for a single short redline set to speed this along.

Samira — helpful if procurement can share the addendum questions by EOD Thursday (2028-05-25). From an ops perspective, if you use the presigned upload approach please compress large logs into a single archive per evidence item; it speeds our ingestion. We'll also provide a temp uploader credential if you prefer a short-lived service account.

-Karthik
VP, Sales
Redwood Inference

Cc: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@orchidsystems.com>, procure@orchidsystems.com
Date: Fri, 25 May 2028 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — Archer account + evidence upload

Laura / Karthik — thanks, that all sounds doable. We will: 

- Upload the completed SIG spreadsheet and SOC 2 PDF to the Archer UI via your presigned links by Monday 2028-05-29 (earlier if possible).
- Provide a named evidence custodian and screenshot of our KMS console (we'll redact session IDs).
- Procurement will send the addendum questions to Karthik by EOD Thursday, as requested.

Please send the presigned upload instructions and the temp uploader creds when ready (we can accept the temp-upload-creds.txt as described in the guide). Once uploaded I'll reply here with the artifact manifest so you can confirm receipt.

Appreciate the smooth coordination — Alex will own the upload and I'll follow up after the first bundle is in Archer.

Best,
Samira Khan
Head of Security Programs
Orchid Systems
